answer: Minted once, never sold, held through two crashes. NFT holding tenure is that patience: a collectible held without sale since mint. A flipper can buy the token today, but the holding history starts today too - the willow that guards the gate is the tree's own growth: slow, visible, and impossible to hurry. A farm needs a hundred such trees, each planted years ago and tended since, and the lotus in the middle of the garden is the sale that never happened. The cedar that shades it all is the mint date, written on chain the day the token was born and never rewritten since.
